document_kind: run-spec template (Strategy D v1; instantiate to /results/<family_id>/rounds/<round_id>/attempts/<run_id>/run-spec.json BEFORE launch)

template_instantiation.rule: Domains, split, costs, gates and the selector/disposition versions are FROZEN before the first run and must be copied from the instantiated round-spec.json. Only the seven placeholders may be substituted. {{script_sha256}} must be the host-side recomputed sha256 of the deployed /scripts/40_strategy_d_run.py (contract 16.2 P10 recomputes it); the run fails closed if the deployed script does not match.

data.bar_labelling: VERIFIED open_time_ms = bar START (UTC); contiguous 3,600,000 ms grid, close_time_ms = open_time_ms + 3,599,999 ms; measured on all four registered symbols over the registered window before this pre-registration was instantiated

funding_truth_status_windows.primary_uses: the complete registered series (modelled + official), as a COST only
funding_truth_status_windows.engine_rule: The position is exposed to every funding settlement whose raw instant lies in the CLOSED interval [entry instant - 1s, exit instant + 1s]. The measured raw jitter of the settlement timestamps is 0..28 ms LATE and never early (all four symbols), so a settlement sitting on a window boundary is charged to the window that holds the position at that instant: the long 15:00-16:00 window pays the 16:00 settlement, the secondary 21:00-24:00 window pays the 00:00 settlement, and the short 01:00-05:00 window pays any settlement inside it (the 0/8/16h grid carries none, but SOLUSDT's early-2022 2h/4h schedule does). A settlement is charged on the position notional at the moment of the charge: the close of the bar that contains it inside the window, or the episode's exit fill price when it lands at the closing boundary. The sign follows the position: a positive rate is a cost to a long and a credit to a short. Settlements outside the closed interval are never charged.

provenance_mirror.legs_status: SOURCE_NORMALIZED - the three clock windows are the source record's own seasonality cells (01:00-05:00 UTC weak, 15:00-16:00 UTC strong, the last three hours of the UTC day positive), normalised to this venue's 1h bar grid. The source studies 38 CEX pair markets, not perpetual futures; the normalisation is registered here and is never re-tuned after seeing results.
provenance_mirror.entry_timing_status: RESEARCH_PROPOSED - the source estimates hourly seasonality only and does not specify an entry/exit convention. This round registers: entry fills at the OPEN of the bar that starts at the window's UTC boundary (the boundary is known ex ante, so the boundary price is executable and no look-ahead is introduced), and the window end is a HARD reduce-only flatten at the close of the bar that ends at the window's closing boundary. Every phase grid uses the same convention; the boundary-alternative track is the registered exception.

boundary_alt_track: REGISTERED: BOUNDARY_ALT_GRIDS = boundary_alt_oos (OOS slice) and boundary_alt_full (full window); each re-runs the whole registered product with the schedule mapped one bar earlier, and the OOS variant is the family-level timezone-fragility reader

expected.arithmetic: 4 cohorts (BNBUSDT/BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT at 1h) x 7 registered strategy cases x 48 DCA configs = 1,344 base combinations per phase grid; x 12 phase grids = 16,128 full case evaluations. A case evaluation = one engine simulation of one joint parameter cell of one cohort on one phase grid.

runtime_expectation.basis: Strategy A v2 measured 103,680 case evaluations in 1,302 s in qlib-run (~12.6 ms per case); Strategy C measured 1,584 cases in 29 s on a single 15m cohort. This family evaluates 16,128 cases on four 1h cohorts, each case holding only the registered clock windows (1-4 bars each).
runtime_expectation.estimate: tens of minutes of engine time plus the 1h bin rebuild for four symbols, i.e. well inside the detached-run budget
runtime_expectation.status: estimate only, extrapolated from measured runs of other families; not a guarantee. The run is launched detached inside the container and its progress is read from the attempt state.json stage plus the run log.

notes: One attempt of round {{round_id}}. The engine rebuilds the qlib .bin store from the read-only raw store, evaluates 4 cohorts x 7 strategy cases x 48 DCA configs on 12 registered phase grids, and writes the registered artifacts. The runner's verdict_recommendation is a recommendation; the final verdict.json is written by the Hermes default card after reading the artifacts back (contract 10.7).
